blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will deploy 2,637 personnel from Nov. 13 to 18 to help manage traffic during the 49th Asean Summit and related gatherings. The agency announced its preparations during a joint press conference with the Department of Transportation and Philippine National Police-Highway Patrol Group on Wednesday. Atty. Victor Nuñez, director of the MMDA’s Traffic Enforcement Group, said the deployment would include street sweepers, members of the agency’s Road Emergency Group, and tow trucks.
